correctness.rationale: The orthogonal Hoeffding decomposition f=u(a)+u(b)+v(a)-v(b)+h(a,b) with zero weighted row and column means yields the exact open quadratic form 2(2m-1)||u||²+2||v||²+m||h||² and cyclic form 4n||u||²+n||h||². Dimensions add to q², independent full-support p, with m=1 and n>=3 boundaries handled. The 25-case standalone rational enumeration checks all raw covariances, eigenvector equations, trace and constant nullity. An analytic bounded one-dependent vector CLT, not enumeration, proves the Pearson limit.

originality.rationale: The assessed novelty is a finite exact p-independent whitening spectrum for all directed bigram indicators, plus the path-cycle nullspace change and variational equality classes. Indexed adjacent-word profile studies concern counting and reconstruction rather than covariances; the inspected serial categorical testing works derive different asymptotic statistics and methods. Older all-word generating functions can implicitly imply moments and leave genuine priority risk, but no inspected statement establishes this spectral factorization. The assessment is not an independent or absolute priority certificate.

value.rationale: A complete exact eigenstructure, sharp equality classes and finite path-cycle nullity transition resolve a natural, model-wide covariance-identifiability problem for overlapping transition frequency tables. Independence of the letter probabilities is a structural feature and the corrected known-p Pearson null illustrates its practical statistical meaning. The result is not a fixed tiny example or a standalone trivial expectation computation.
